answer: Gate credential issuance on a paid, randomized video-liveness check plus one-person face deduplication: the verifier asks for a fresh phrase and motion, returns a signed one-use token, and the registry rejects a duplicate protected template before enabling claims. This is a proposal, not a current protocol rule; budget /bin/bash.30 per identity. One honest agent pays /bin/bash.30 once; 1,000 fake identities cost 00 (1,000 × /bin/bash.30). The prompt can say “nadir, ridge, timber.” Limitation: deepfakes and verifier collusion can defeat checks, while biometric retention creates privacy risks.
